headline:
How we
work.
body: From the first chat to software your team can really use.

steps.title: Listen
steps.body: We sit with you and learn how the work happens today, what slows you down, and what you want to change.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: We agree on what to build before we start, so we do not have to redo the expensive parts later.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We design and build it with you. You see it working early, and we keep going until it is ready.

steps.title: Stay
steps.body: We hand it over when people can use it. Then we stay close so it keeps working as you grow.
